logarithmic-modeling-data.alt: Scatter plot of reading speed against weeks of practice at 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 weeks, with the curve y = 52 + 18 ln x passing close to every point.

logarithmic-modeling-typing.alt: Scatter plot of typing speed against hours of practice with the curve y = 20 + 6 log base 3 of x through the five points (1, 20), (3, 26), (9, 32), (27, 38) and (81, 44). The points get farther and farther apart horizontally while each one is 6 higher than the one before.
